exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Present simple vs present continuous in operations

items.prompt: The vessel usually ___ on Mondays, but this week it ___ on Wednesday because of the port strike.
items.hintAfterError: Rotina ('usually') pede o presente simples com -s na 3ª pessoa; algo temporário ('this week') pede be + -ing.

items.prompt: This morning we ___ with two exceptions.
items.hintAfterError: Algo acontecendo agora, nesta manhã: use o presente contínuo (be + verbo com -ing).

items.prompt: Our team ___ with three ports on every shipment.
items.hintAfterError: 'On every shipment' indica rotina — presente simples, e 'our team' é 3ª pessoa do singular.
